title: Caravan writs
changes: Two new war writs on the bounty boards: escort one of your clan's supply carts down a named road, or raid a rival clan's cart on a road at your front.
An escort writ is done when the cart you walked beside arrives; a raid writ when your blow fells the cart.
They count toward the same three war writs a day and pay gold, renown and valor like the others.
